demoLabel: Demo project in a Salesforce demo org, test data only, not a client project.
returnWindowOrigin: Brief: Start a Return topic explains the return window; 30 days from delivery is the demo policy. Single source — Flow constant Return_Window_Days and seed data must match this value.
returnWindowBasis: Order.Delivered_Date__c (custom demo field); falls back to Order.EffectiveDate when empty.
nonReturnableOrigin: Brief requires eligibility by order date and product type. Product2.Family value 'Final Sale' marks demo items excluded from returns; Create_Return_Request flow enforces it. Seed data includes one such order.
